items.title: Iran-Linked Hackers Force UK Power Plant Offline in Unprecedented Four-Day Cyberattack
items.description: A cyberattack attributed to hackers linked to Iran forced a British power plant offline for four consecutive days last month, marking what officials describe as the first successful attack of its kind against UK energy infrastructure.
